comment: 45yo female, sedentary office worker, Western dietary pattern — Trichopoulou Mediterranean Diet Score (MDS) 2/9 (lowest tertile): high red/processed meat (~5x/week), high refined carbohydrate + sweets, low olive oil + vegetables + whole grains + fish + legumes. PREDIMED-style score in lowest tertile; 14-item MEDAS = 5. No current cancer diagnosis. Mediterranean dietary pattern = high olive oil, vegetables, fruits, whole grains, legumes, nuts, fish; moderate dairy + wine with meals; low red/processed meat + sweets. EPIC + Nurses' Health Study + PREDIMED: high adherence ~12-15% reduction in overall cancer incidence + mortality, strongest signals for CRC, breast, gastric, HCC. Engine fires RF-LIFESTYLE-LOW-MEDITERRANEAN-DIET-PREVENTION (any_of: mediterranean_diet_score_lt_4:true OR medas_score_lt_7:true OR predimed_lowest_tertile:true) and routes to PreventionPlan: standard = structured dietary-pattern counseling (registered-dietitian referral; Mediterranean-pattern adoption goal MDS ≥6) + USPSTF-cadence CRC screening; alternative = brief counseling + screening per anchor. Validates v0.3 diet-pattern pilot. Anchored DIS-CRC; multi-cancer benefit framed in rationale.
